title: Place Value Worksheets | 1st Math Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 1.NBT.B.2, 1.NBT.B.3, 1.NBT.C.5

Give your learners extra practice with Place Value! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 2-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (10 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Tens and Ones to 100
  • How Many Tens?
  • Place Value Match
  • More or Less Than 50?
  • Count by 10s
  • Hop by 10s
  • Answer key (2 pages): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Tens and Ones to 100, How Many Tens?, Place Value Match, More or Less Than 50?, Count by 10s, Hop by 10s), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Math Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
